findings.current: It was much the same for Gungsung and the Embroidered Uniform Guard, who still hadn’t returned after rooting out the Murong Family’s threat.
findings.defect: Uses an unmapped transliteration instead of the established title.
findings.rationale: 궁성 is the Bow Saint, not a personal name.
findings.replacement: It was much the same for the Bow Saint and the Embroidered Uniform Guard, who still hadn’t returned after rooting out the Murong Family’s threat.
findings.source: 아직 귀환하지 못한 궁성과 금의위 역시 크게 다르지 않았다.

findings.current: And that gap in timing, however brief, might become a butterfly’s wings flapping somewhere far away and change a great many things.
findings.defect: Reverses the duration: the source says the gap is by no means short.
findings.rationale: 결코 짧지 않은 explicitly rules out a brief gap.
findings.replacement: And that considerable gap in timing might become the flap of a butterfly’s wings somewhere far away and change a great many things.
findings.source: 그리고 결코 짧지 않은 그 시간차가

findings.current: “Oh, would you look at that. Is that my little brother?”
findings.defect: Calls Mukyung Taekyung’s little brother rather than the family’s second son, reversing their seniority and obscuring the ensuing joke about omitting “hyung.”
findings.rationale: 둘째 identifies the second-born sibling; Taekyung is the younger brother.
findings.replacement: “Oh, would you look at that. Isn’t that our family’s second son?”

findings.current: “What? Did I say anything wrong? You are my little brother.”
findings.defect: Again reverses the brothers’ seniority and loses Taekyung’s deliberately title-free way of calling Mukyung the second son.
findings.rationale: Mukyung objects to the missing 형님, not to being called a younger brother.
findings.replacement: “What? Did I say anything wrong? You are the second son.”

findings.current: “Don’t you dare let anyone else beat you before I catch up.”
findings.defect: Turns a plea that Taekyung not fall to someone else into a warning against losing a contest.
findings.rationale: 쓰러지지 말 것 carries the danger of being struck down, which gives the farewell its emotional force.
findings.replacement: “Until I catch up, don’t let anyone else take you down. Ever.”
findings.source: 절대 다른 놈한테 쓰러지지 말 것.

findings.current: Lee Seowol, forcing a smile as she put the death of her uncle and steadfast guardian, Cheol Mubaek—the Tiger of Mount Heng—behind her.
findings.defect: Omits that Cheol Mubaek was like another father to Seowol.
findings.rationale: 또 한 사람의 아버지나 다름없던 states a distinct, emotionally important relationship.
findings.replacement: Lee Seowol, forcing a smile despite the death of her uncle, Cheol Mubaek—the Tiger of Mount Heng—who had been her staunchest guardian and almost another father to her.
findings.source: 가장 든든한 후견인이자 또 한 사람의 아버지나 다름없던 의숙, 항산호 철무백의 죽음을 뒤로한 채 애써 미소 짓고 있는 이소월.

findings.current: Across the rough table, the guest sat with perfect composure despite an hour of silence. He answered,
findings.defect: Halves the duration of the silence.
findings.rationale: A 시진 is approximately two hours, not one.
findings.replacement: Across the rough table, the guest sat with perfect composure despite a full shichen—about two hours—of silence. He answered,
findings.source: 한 시진 동안 이어진 침묵 속에서도

findings.current: The words came out in a casual, familiar tone.
findings.defect: Loses the marked hierarchy: the younger Mae speaks down to the much older Song Ho as though it were natural.
findings.rationale: 하대 denotes downward, informal address; the preceding age contrast makes that register shift salient.
findings.replacement: He spoke to the older man as an elder would to a junior, as though it were the most natural thing in the world.

findings.defect: Reverses which option Mae says most people would choose.
findings.rationale: 전자 refers to being given the answer, the first of Song Ho’s two stated options.

summary: Several factual reversals and lost relationship cues need correction; the remaining issues are localized.
